name_zh: 三境溯游 · 秘境回响
tagline_zh: 从北部湾到云贵高原的 14 日跨国人文探险之旅
tagline_en: A 14-day overland journey from the Gulf to the Plateau
regions_zh: 南宁 · 下龙 · 云南建水 / 弥勒 / 昆明
regions_en: Nanning · Ha Long · JianShui · Mile · Kuming
feature_zh:
这是一条跨越国境、跨越海拔的史诗级「穿越」长线，从湿热的海洋，一步步走向高远的高原。适合有较长时间“沉浸“西南中国与越北区域探索发现的深度旅行者。

旅程在下龙湾真正拉开序幕，乘上一艘优雅的游船真正驶入巨石林立的海中央；随后搭乘轮渡隐入吉婆岛，吹一吹狂劲的野生海风。当傍晚来临，一列复古的百年米轨火车将载着您，从海防缓缓驶入河内老街的百年烟火里。在云雾缭绕的沙坝，留足整整一天的奢侈时间：上午登顶番西邦峰，俯瞰滚滚云海；下午慢步踱进猫猫村，在梯田与黑苗村落的古老呼吸中沉淀。越过河口国境线，风吹过，燥热退去。进入云南建水的古城墨香与普者黑孤峰之下的万亩荷塘。海的辽阔、山的雾气、高原的纯净，一次旅程都能体会得到。
feature_en:
This is an epic cross-border traverse — from the humid coast up to the high plateau. Best for travellers who can take the time to immerse in southwest China and northern Vietnam.

The journey opens on Ha Long Bay aboard a classic cruise among limestone karsts, then a ferry to Cat Ba’s wild sea breeze. By evening, a century-old metre-gauge train rolls from Hai Phong into Hanoi’s old streets. Give Sapa a full day: Fansipan above the clouds in the morning, Cat Cat’s terraces and Black H’mong life in the afternoon. Across Hekou the heat softens into Yunnan — Jianshui’s old town and Puzhehei’s lotus wetlands. Sea, mist and highland light in one arc.

tagline_zh: 穿行于蔗海、梯田与法式老街的慢节奏人文巡游
tagline_en: A slow cultural circuit through sugarcane fields, rice terraces and French-era streets
regions_zh: 南宁 · 下龙 · 吉婆 · 河内 · 沙坝 · 龙州 · 南宁
regions_en: Nanning · Ha Long · Cat Ba · Hanoi · Sapa · Longzhou · Nanning
feature_zh:
这是一条以南宁为原点的传奇闭环，专为时间紧凑、但对旅行深度绝不妥协的旅人而设计。在这里，11天不只是一段时间，而是一场文化密度极高的边境漫游。

自东兴口岸出境进入下龙，再轮渡上吉婆岛，在海上喀斯特的日落里放慢脚步；随后跨海缆车入海防，一头扎进河内老街的机车与咖啡香。夜宿百年米轨，清晨抵达沙坝，登番西邦、走猫猫村，把梯田与云雾留在身上。

归途经友谊关回到龙州观堂：天琴壮寨与蔗海骑行之后，再赴德天瀑布与明仕田园，最后回到南宁收束。这不仅是一段目不暇接的精彩行程，更是一次精神的深度隐遁。
feature_en:
This is a legendary loop originating from Nanning, crafted for travelers with limited time but an uncompromising desire for depth. Over 11 days, immerse yourself in a culturally dense borderlands odyssey.

Cross at Dongxing into Ha Long, then ferry to Cat Ba for a quieter night among the karst seascape. Cable to Hai Phong and drop into Hanoi’s Old Quarter — drip coffee, cyclo lanes, West Lake after dark. Sleep on the century-old metre-gauge train to Lao Cai, wake in Sapa’s mist, climb Fansipan and walk Cat Cat village.

Return via Friendship Pass to Longzhou’s Guantang courtyard: Tianqin Zhuang village and a ride through the sugarcane sea, then Detian Falls and Mingshi Pastoral before the loop closes in Nanning.

name_zh: 崇左栖山 · 涠洲枕海
tagline_zh: 秘境丽世与涠洲岛观鲸，小众野奢与深度在地体验
tagline_en: Seven days from karst peaks to a volcanic island
regions_zh: 南宁 · 崇左 · 北海 · 涠洲岛
feature_zh:
我们最受欢迎的度假之旅！整个旅程丰富、宁静，有山水大海，人文交流和自然美学。特别适合愿意花几天时间好好”奖励“自己，或想与家人好友共度宁静时光的你。

旅程中不忙着打卡，不去人挤人的地方，全程入住顶流酒店。无论是在崇左秘境丽世度假村，独家的德天瀑布观瀑景苑中观赏飞瀑落雨，还是在涠洲岛的滴水丹屏的火山岩悬崖之上的方岛·巨鲸悬崖酒店看一望无际的南中国海，从容不迫的节奏下，有的是好奇心满满的探索与发现。

在喀斯特峰林与火山海岛之间，每天悠闲看日出日落，火山岩、果冻海，去赶海追鲸。收获的绝不只是美景大片，更把一份海岛原住民特有的松弛感带回家，久久难忘。
feature_en:
Our most sought-after vacation! Rich yet tranquil — mountains, open sea, culture and natural beauty. Ideal if you want a few days to truly treat yourself, or quiet time with family and friends.

No rushing to tourist traps, no crowded spots — just an unhurried pace with top-tier stays. Whether you watch mist and waterfalls from LUX* Chongzuo or look out over the South China Sea from Found Land Whale Cliff Resort on Weizhou’s volcanic cliffs, every moment is curiosity and quiet discovery.

Between karst peaks and volcanic shores: sunrises, sunsets, jelly seas, beachcombing and whale watching. You bring home more than photos — the deep, lasting ease of island life.
